prerequisites: A contract must be concluded between the company and the student regarding the implementation of the practical phase. The department provides the model contract recommended by the MIWF.
The student must immediately inform the student service about the conclusion of a contract.
The student selects a lecturer/examiner from the study program as a supervisor.

learning_outcomes.text: Apply the activities and learning outcomes acquired during the course of study in a practical manner.
Independently work on engineering projects and develop suitable solution strategies.
Integration, analysis, problem-solving, presentation, and communication competencies should be imparted and expanded.

syllabus_topics: The content results from the field of activity of the chosen company or operation and should include an engineering task.
At the end of the practical phase, a proof of activity must be created by the supervising company and a final report by the students.
Students should be individually and professionally advised by the supervising university lecturers during the practical phase.

assessment_methods.method: Positive employment reference from the supervising examiner

assessment_rules: For the completion of the practical phase, a report, which should generally not exceed 10 pages, and a positive employment reference from the supervising examiner must be submitted. Credit points are awarded upon successful completion of the module examination.
